text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! You've done well to recover over 
this past year.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
There are no issues with her running. Good 
luck in the Flower Cup.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you very much!

Cesario's legs made a complete recovery 
right before the Flower Cup!
choice_data_list:
Let's do our best in our first target race 
in a while!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes...! I will definitely win...!
And the day of the Flower Cup arrived.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, okay!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I did some mental training using all 
the race development predictions you 
calculated for me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Better safe than sorry... Thanks to that, 
I was able to relax.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Oh, right. Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-san gave me some American snacks. 
Would you like to try them with me once 
we're done today?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Rumor has it that it's extremely sour. I 
watched a video of someone eating it, and 
it was so funny... Fufu!

Showing no signs of brooding, she heads 
into the race with just the right amount 
of tension.

"You could tell at a single glance that 
she was in peak condition, both in mind 
and body."

With that, I headed into the pre-race 
interview looking forward to everyone's 
reactions, but—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
To get straight to it! How are you feeling 
today?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'd say it's exceptionally good. I'm 
feeling pleasantly giddy about having a 
target race again after so long.
(Whoa...!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...! To not let it show in your 
demeanor at all—truly impressive!

Her reaction was slightly different from 
what I had expected.

"Maybe understanding Cesario has helped me 
develop a sharper eye for observation 
without even realizing it!"

Being able to tell her physical condition 
with just a glance... Seeing the wish from 
that day take form, I instinctively clench 
my fist.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: You haven't won yet, you know?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Just kidding. But from the look on 
your face, something good must have 
happened."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Seeing you happy makes me happy too, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...That said, I'm sure you'll be even 
happier with what's to come today, so—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you hold onto this feeling of 
joy, okay?

Overcoming the pain—a goal race one year 
in the making. Cesario's story begins to 
move once again...!
